title: Coverage Summary: Service Included in ComfortLease Rent
content:
**ComfortLease Equipment Leases — service included for the lessee**

The lessee's service calls are dispatched at front-of-line priority. Maintenance visits, repairs where repairs are included, and after-hours service where after-hours service is included are provided at no charge to the lessee, except damage from flood, fire, lightning, vandalism or owner alteration. Replacement filters are supplied at each maintenance visit where the system includes filters.

## Inclusions by system

| Leased system | Maintenance visits per lease year | Repair parts and labor included | After-hours calls without premium | Replacement filters at each maintenance visit | Dispatch priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | 1 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Front of line |
| ComfortLease Central Air | 1 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Front of line |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Front of line |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Front of line |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Front of line |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Front of line |

## Damage not covered by the included repairs

On every system the following causes are excluded:

- flood
- fire
- lightning
- vandalism
- owner alteration

## Points of judgement (hypothetical calls)

| Hypothetical call on a ComfortLease lease | Provided at no charge to the lessee? |
|---|---|
| Second maintenance visit in a lease year on a ComfortLease Heat Pump | Yes — two visits per lease year are included |
| Second maintenance visit in a lease year on a ComfortLease Central Air | Not an included visit — one visit per lease year is included |
| Evening repair call for a failed blower motor, no excluded cause | Yes — repairs and after-hours service are included |
| Repair of a condenser damaged by lightning | No — damage from lightning is excluded |
| Repair after the homeowner rewired the unit | No — owner alteration is excluded |
